name: Agent-First Pay
synopsis: A payment tool for AI agents — send and receive across five networks through one interface, with spending limits you control.
intent: Give AI agents a persistent cryptocurrency payment client that supports Lightning (NWC, phoenixd, lnbits), Solana, EVM (Base, Arbitrum), eCash (Cashu), and Bitcoin on-chain (BDK + Esplora, SegWit/Taproot), with JSONL pipe mode for scripting and a single HTTP domain API — wallets, balances, receives, sends, transactions and spend limits as resources under /v1, described by an OpenAPI 3.2 contract the daemon serves at /openapi.json — which is also how one afpay node federates to another, so the agent sends payment requests as JSON and receives structured results without managing wallet connections or key material
mutations: Keep an unknown submission's key Pending instead of releasing it for a second payment
Sign Solana and EVM sends once and broadcast the same bytes to every endpoint
Price Bitcoin fees from the chain source, capped at 1000 sat/vB
Fail EVM quotes instead of pricing gas at zero
Report a Lightning 200 that does not identify the payment as unknown
Refuse an unreadable BDK changeset instead of starting a fresh wallet
Keep PostgreSQL backup passwords out of process arguments

bonds.reason: All request/response fields use Agent-First Data suffix conventions and output formats
